test_llama4_text_generation: test the Llama-4 model text generation using the flash_llama4 client with a seed and max tokens
test_llama4_multimodal_image_url: test the Llama-4 multimodal chat by passing an image URL and a text prompt to the client
test_llama4_multimodal_image_description: test the Llama-4 model image description capability by sending a cow image and asking what is shown
test_llama4_base64_image_chat: test the Llama-4 chat with a base64-encoded image data URL for RGBA, RGB PNG, or JPEG formats
create_image_to_data_url: create a function that converts a Pillow Image to a base64 data URL string for PNG or JPEG formats
